title: It Depends, and What Would Happen
label: ch:ja-it-depends-and-what-would-happen
canDo: I can say what something depends on (tenki ni yorimasu), say what is done in a given case (ame no baai wa), say what would happen if (okane ga attara, kau deshō), and tell a trip in six connected lines.

payoff.summary: Complete JA-R261-it-depends: say what a plan depends on and what would happen if.
